ex.en: He is now either in Rome or in Paris.
ex.zh: 他現在不是在羅馬就是在巴黎。

ex.en: Let’s either speak Chinese, or not speak at all.
ex.zh: 我們要嘛說中文，要嘛就別說話。

ex.en: Tom, if you're not going, I'm not going either.
ex.zh: 湯姆，如果你不去，我也不去。

ex.en: I don't know why the meeting was postponed, either.
ex.zh: 我也不知道為什麼會議延期了。

ex.en: You can reach the park by either road.
There are many stores on either side of the street.
